units.source_text: 老头用舌尖舔了舔上嘴唇，脸上浮起毫不在乎的浅笑。

en.t: The old man licked his upper lip with the tip of his tongue, and a faint, unconcerned smile rose on his face.

units.source_text: 不，也许根本不是浅笑，只是为了抵挡被风扬起的沙子，才让眼角堆起皱纹的吧。

en.t: No, perhaps it was not a smile at all; maybe the wrinkles had only gathered at the corners of his eyes to ward off the sand whipped up by the wind.

units.source_text: 可是，连一根皱纹都没有逃过男人激动的眼睛。

en.t: But not even a single wrinkle escaped the man's excited eyes.
